OPINION OF ADVOCATE GENERAL

Keywords

Artificial intelligence — Risk classification — Fundamental rights

Summary

The Advocate General proposes that the Court should rule on the interpretation of the AI Act.

Parties

TechCorp International v European Commission

Subject of the case

Request for a preliminary ruling on Article 6 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689.

Grounds

1. The referring court raises the question of classification of AI systems under the risk-based framework.

2. In my view, the classification must account for the intended purpose of the system.

3. Article 6 of Regulation 2024/1689 establishes the criteria for high-risk AI systems.

Decision on costs

As this is an opinion, costs are not determined at this stage.

Operative part

I propose that the Court answer the questions referred as follows: Article 6 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 must be interpreted as establishing a cumulative test for high-risk classification.
